Serial constraints cleared: `packages/cli` is free. **#5127 was returned to `needs-user-decision` this round with no PR and no commits** — its branch is empty and its claim released, so the other arm of this same command is not in flight. Nothing else touches `packages/cli`.

## Scope — direction 1 ONLY (the JSONC parse), and it is deliberately DECOUPLED from #5127

This card lists three directions and recommends deciding alongside #5127's marker. **I am scoping you to the first one**, and the reason is in the card's own boundary section: the parse happens *before* any judgement of the file's contents, so a positive-marker gate cannot skip it — *"Fixing either leaves the other exactly as it is."* Only directions 2 and 3 couple to #5127.

That decoupling is the point. #5127's ruling was falsified by measurement this round and it is back in the maintainer's box. **This defect is worse than #5127's and must not wait on it**: #5127 prints a warning, while this one **fails the run** — exit 1 in any TypeScript project, 64 errors in this repo, and `pnpm check` red on `main` today.

⛔ **Do not** implement direction 2 (demote parse failures to warnings / hard-fail only on marker-carrying files) or direction 3 (narrow the scan). Both encode a decision that belongs to #5127 and to the maintainer. If you conclude direction 1 cannot be done without one of them, **stop and report**.

## The dependency question — read this, it is the one thing that could make this card not yours

Direction 1 means parsing with a JSONC-tolerant reader, and the card correctly flags that this "adds a dependency". A **new third-party runtime dependency is a maintainer-floor decision** and is not mine to authorise.

I checked before dispatching, and it is not new: **`jsonc-parser@^3.3.1` is already a declared runtime dependency of `@object-ui/app-shell`** and is already in `pnpm-lock.yaml`. So using it in `@object-ui/cli` adopts a package the product already ships and the org has already accepted — a new dependency *edge*, not a new dependency to the fleet. On that basis I am authorising it, and I am flagging the call to the maintainer in this round's report so it can be vetoed.

**Your hard stop**: `@object-ui/cli` is a **published** package. If adding `jsonc-parser` to it would pull **any** new transitive package into what users install, or if the version already in the lockfile cannot be satisfied without a bump elsewhere — **stop and report**. Verify this; do not assume it. ⛔ Do not reach for a different JSONC library, and ⛔ do not hand-roll a comment-stripping regex: the card names the reason (string-literal edge cases — a `//` inside a JSON string value is not a comment), and a subtly wrong stripper is worse than the bug.

## Premise — re-verify, then reproduce

Verified on `origin/main`: `check.ts` globs `**/*.{json,yaml,yml}` and hands every `.json` straight to `JSON.parse`; a throw is the **only** thing that increments `errors`, and non-zero `errors` is the only thing that calls `process.exit(1)`.

Reproduce it yourself before fixing — the card gives the recipe (note `@object-ui/types` must be built first; `dist/cli.js` imports its `dist/zod/index.zod.js` at load). Confirm the 64/exit-1 figure rather than quoting mine.

## Tests

- A `tsconfig.json` with a `//` comment **and** a trailing comma parses cleanly, produces no error, and does not affect the exit code.
- **Genuinely malformed JSON still errors and still exits 1.** This is the assertion that stops the fix from becoming "never fail on anything" — a tolerant reader that swallows real syntax errors would pass a suite built only from the happy path.
- The warning arm is **untouched**: a file with an unrecognised root `type` still warns exactly as before, and still does not change the exit code. #5127 must be left in precisely the state it is in.
- Repo-level: `objectui check` at the repo root goes from 64 errors / exit 1 to 0 errors / exit 0 (the 47 warnings stay — they are #5127's, not yours).

Reverse-verify: restore `check.ts`, keep the tests, predict which go red **before** running, report predicted vs observed.

## Gates

Derive from your diff (`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` is **objectstack-only**; here derive from `.github/workflows` and `package.json`). A dependency addition may bring `check-phantom-dependencies.mjs` into play — run it. Changeset required (`@object-ui/cli`); `patch` or `minor`, ⛔ never `major`.

⛔ **Do not background a long check and end your turn.** Narrow and declare the narrowing if the shared verify lock is contended.

## Deliver

Draft PR against `main`, first body line `Fixes #5237`. Push the branch early. Return the JSON report and post it as a comment whose first line is the literal `<!-- os-dev-report -->` marker.
